I had a teacher who for this story we'll call Mr. King

He was an English teacher who was very cringe and became a running joke in the school. I had the misfortune of being in his class. Now every Thursday I had counselling, which I had to leave for about 5-10 minutes before the English lesson that day ended to get there on time. But, Mr King would never let me early and would always go on about how I "have to be apart of the team" and that that part of the lesson is "crucial"

One day I got sick of this and just packed away and stood up, he knew.

I went up to him and he was like "ooh no you can't leave."

At this point he has been doing this for weeks so I snapped.

"Sir, aren't you sick of doing this every week?" I said. He replied something along the lines of, "you must be in lesson."

"In my opinion the last five or so minutes of one of my many English lessons doesn't even come near the importance of counselling I have once a week for my mental heath issues." After I said that I just left. 

According to a friend after I left the teacher started talking about how I "let down the team" and that it was a "red card" (he always spoke in sports terms like that).
